verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the serum bottle is pulled out of its pink circle and shrunk into the bottom-left, leaving an empty circle on the right that the CTA button collides with. The attribution is moved away from its quote to the top-right, and the enlarged logo floats in the middle with no relationship to anything. B keeps the original's structure (quote, attribution, CTA and logo on a left column, bottle in a circle on the right) with proportions intact. Its only flaws are minor: the logo and CTA text are small, and the space under the logo is a bit loose.
